messages:
maya: Quick sync: we need a compact UX for auto-fallback decisions that shows mode, trigger, and quota impact. cc @liam @sarah
liam: Idea: single-line status chip on rollout card with mode icon, reason shortcode, and small quota delta badge. click opens audit playback.
sarah: Add 'sample-only' toggle to test without changing routing; show sample requests + projected token delta.
dan: API: return enums in status endpoint and emit header e.g. `X-Redwood-Fallback: mode=soft;reason=latency;id=0x7a1b`. Support `?dry_run=true`.
aj: Keep header tiny (128 bytes max). Use lowercase enum strings and semicolons.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary `autofallback-ui` started by @liam  logs: https://ci.redwood/run/4750
maya: UX asks: chip + tooltip, 'Audit' button for sampled requests, cooldown pill if oscillating, and approver UI for protected rollouts.
liam: Cooldown shown as "cooldown: 2m"; pause button callable via API.
sarah: 'Why did we fallback?' modal should show top 3 signals and example requests.
dan: I'll emit `decision_id` in telemetry and ensure sampled=true for previews.
aj: Will update API docs and telemetry schema (add fallback_reason, decision_id).
maya: Example copy: `[Soft ▮ latency] — Quota est: -3.8% (monthly). Audit`
sarah: Add link to Optimize suggestions for remediation.
liam: Permissions: edits require rollout-owner + ops signoff for protected rollouts. Show approvers on page.
ops-bot: incident-bot: alert: sampling spike on route `payment-checkout` 2025-02-10T08:14Z (sample-only).
dan: Will correlate `decision_id=0x7a1b` with logs.
maya: Action list: liam PR (UI chip + pause), dan PR (dry_run + decision_id), aj docs, sarah mock, maya copy. Sync tomorrow 09:30.
